title: Power electronics thermal placement
purpose: Place devices, heat sinks, drivers and temperature sensors so losses stay within thermal-path limits, shared-sink insulation is maintained and temperature feedback is used correctly.
applicable_conditions: Through-hole or module SiC devices on heat sinks with natural or forced air
Boards where drivers must sit beside heat-sinked devices
not_applicable: Transient thermal impedance, power cycling, CFD
principles: P_max = (T_J,max - T_A,max) / R_th,total including shared-sink share
Rated insulating interface for shared sinks
Loss estimates over the envelope including loss of ZVS
Thermal placement must not lengthen electrical loops
Thermistor temperature is not junction temperature
procedure: Choose sink, interface, airflow and compute P_max
Place devices and keep capacitors/magnetics out of exhaust (review)
Place and route thermistors through isolated channels
pcb_constraints: Creepage from sink to HV pins
known_limitations: Single reference thermal model at 40 degC
